name: Visit Madeira and Faroe Islands
summary:
Have you ever been in Madeira or Faroe Islands? Did you ever saw the beauty these this islands? Now you got an opportunity to fast travel there, just by putting your headset on.

Immerse yourself into 360 3D videos of the nicest locations on these islands. Let your headset take you there in full 360 3D with spatial audio in max allowed quality.
